Over the course of 27 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. - Internal Internship (12 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention. Once you're ready to start working, you'll be matched with a position that aligns with your experience and skills, such as a software developer, system administrator, or business analyst. jobs.description:
About UsDe Pijp Boutique Hotel is a premium, intimate design hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighborhood. Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00). You will manage late arrivals, early departures, safety checks, and basic food and beverage preparation for the morning. This role requires high autonomy, a sharp eye for detail, and an absolute commitment to maintaining our premium boutique standards.

Functie-eisen:
What We Are Looking For
• Experience: Previous experience in hotel night auditing, front desk operations, or security/hospitality service is highly preferred.
• Reliability & Accountability: You are someone who understands that a small team relies heavily on your precision. You do not cut corners and take your job tasks seriously.
• Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken). Knowledge of Dutch or another European language is a great bonus.
• Legal Status: You must hold a valid EU passport or an unrestricted Dutch work permit with a valid BSN. We do not provide visa sponsorship.What We Offer
• A competitive part-time salary scaled to your experience in accordance with the Horeca-CAO, including applicable night-shift allowances.
• A safe, beautiful, and premium working environment in Amsterdam.
• Independence and trust to manage the property autonomously.
